failure.step: B3-004 R8 operational scope and soft-delete synthetic proof

rootCause: The Node Firebase Functions client invocation did not attach authenticated request context immediately after custom-token sign-in. The callable therefore rejected before the product scope/delete logic was exercised.
fix: Keep Firebase custom-token authentication but explicitly obtain the Firebase ID token and send it as Authorization: Bearer to the isolated us-east1 Preview callable. Also verify/clean only the known failed-run synthetic IDs before the rerun.
